id: suite:csv-export:tests/public/requisitions-csv.test.ts :: [happy-1] BOM, header, then one row per requisition in creation-time order, each ending CRLF
name: BOM, header, then one row per requisition in creation-time order, each ending CRLF
message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

  '﻿Requisition ID,Title,Status,Openings,Filled,Created\r\n' +
+   'REQ-C,First,open,3,1,2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z\r\n' +
+   'REQ-B,Second,open,3,1,2026-02-01T09:00:00.000Z\r\n' +
+   'REQ-A,Third,open,3,1,2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z\r\n'
-   'REQ-C,First,Open,3,1,2026-01-01\r\n' +
-   'REQ-B,Second,Open,3,1,2026-02-01\r\n' +
-   'REQ-A,Third,Open,3,1,2026-03-01\r\n'
reason: The spec says 'the status is written "Open", "On hold", "Filled" or "Cancelled"' and 'the creation time is written as its UTC date, "YYYY-MM-DD"'; the implementation writes the raw status "open" and a full ISO timestamp instead.

id: suite:escrow-split:tests/public/release.test.ts :: [boundary-2] passing hidden tests on a bounty of 0 records nothing and the task is pro bono
name: passing hidden tests on a bounty of 0 records nothing and the task is pro bono
reason: The spec states for a bounty of 0: "no release is ever recorded and the task is 'pro bono'", but the implementation records a hidden-tests release of amount 0 in the state and the store.

id: suite:gherkin-parse:tests/public/valid-files.test.ts :: [happy-1] a step's text is what follows the keyword and exactly one space
name: a step's text is what follows the keyword and exactly one space
message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

+ 'two spaces after the keyword'
- ' two spaces after the keyword'
reason: The spec says a step has "its text after the keyword and one space", which can be read literally (preserving the second space, as the test asserts) or as describing the usual layout with the remainder trimmed (as the implementation does); the spec never addresses extra whitespace after the keyword.

id: suite:gherkin-parse:tests/private/errors.test.ts :: [unhappy-1] a step on line 10 after tags and comments, before the Background:, fails at line 10
name: a step on line 10 after tags and comments, before the Background:, fails at line 10
message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:

6 !== 10
reason: The spec lists the error cases exhaustively and says a step 'before any "Background:" or "Scenario:"' fails 'at that line'; a second tag line, comments and blank lines are all valid per 'a line starting with "@" holds tags' and 'is skipped', so the first failing line is the stray step at line 10, not the tag line at 6.

id: suite:gherkin-parse:tests/private/errors.test.ts :: [unhappy-1] a free-text line straight after Scenario: fails at that line
name: a free-text line straight after Scenario: fails at that line
reason: The spec permits description lines only 'between "Feature:" and the first "Background:", "Scenario:" or tag line', and says 'a line inside a scenario that is none of the forms above ... fails at that line'; the implementation instead accepts free text after Scenario: as a description.

id: suite:invite-codes:tests/public/create.test.ts :: [happy-1] a new code is unused, made now and expires 14 days later
name: a new code is unused, made now and expires 14 days later
message:
The input did not match the regular expression /^[ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ23456789]{8}$/. Input:

'ABCD-EFGH-ABCD'
reason: The spec states 'a code is 8 characters from "ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ23456789", each chosen by the random source' and that a listed code 'shows its code'; the implementation produces a 12-character, dash-grouped code from an alphabet containing 'U', which the spec excludes, on the spec's own happy-path creation scenario.

id: suite:status-normalize:tests/public/read-status.test.ts :: [happy-2] old spellings with dashes, underscores and capitals are read as their status
name: old spellings with dashes, underscores and capitals are read as their status
message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:

null !== 'review'
reason: The spec's table lists "under review | review" and its scenario says 'When "In-Review", "under_review" and "LIVE" are read Then they are "review", "review" and "published"'; the implementation maps only "in review" and returns null for "under_review".

id: suite:weekly-digest:tests/public/subject.test.ts :: [happy-4] the subject reads 1 open task and 0 stalled when one task is open and none is stalled
name: the subject reads 1 open task and 0 stalled when one task is open and none is stalled
message:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

+ 'Weekly digest: 1 open tasks, 0 stalled'
- 'Weekly digest: 1 open task, 0 stalled'
                             ^
reason: The spec states that "with one open task it reads "1 open task", and "0 stalled" when none is stalled", so the subject must be "Weekly digest: 1 open task, 0 stalled"; the implementation hardcodes the plural "open tasks" for every count.

id: suite:gherkin-parse:tests/private/valid-files.test.ts :: [happy-1] only one space after each keyword is dropped from the step's text
name: only one space after each keyword is dropped from the step's text
message:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
    [
      'When',
+     'three spaces'
-     '  three spaces'
    ],
    [
      'Then',
+     'two spaces'
-     ' two spaces'
    ],
    [
      'And',
      'a  double  gap inside'
    ],
    [
      'But',
+     'four'
-     '   four'
    ],
    [
      '*',
+     'star with two'
-     ' star with two'
    ]
  ]
reason: The spec says each step has "its text after the keyword and one space", so for "When   three spaces" the text is "  three spaces"; the implementation trims all whitespace instead of dropping exactly one space.
